title: Opening at the Paddock in September and meeting Sid Davilla
summary: She sang at the Paddock for eight weeks, and asked Sid Davilla for an audition at the Mardi Gras Lounge.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: and then in 1951 round about what September you used to open up at the paddock
yeah it was in September yeah it was in September and you were playing with who
Alphonse Kikwu's group there I was singing with him well no he wasn't there
Alphonse was in California when I started there but the bunch he's playing with was there they was expecting him to come but I was singing with Russell the piano player there
and how long did you stay at the paddock

I think it was eight weeks eight weeks and the same day the same day that I was on Papa Stopper's program Mr. Sid Davila was there being interviewed and when he went out I went out behind him and I said he said over the radio that he was just getting ready to open up the Mardi Gras lounge and thus and so you know see so when I went out I said to him Mr. Davila if you're going to open up a new place would you give me an audition and he said yes sure I'll give you an audition I said well here's my telephone but he never called up
